Seek mechanisms that distinguish model identifiers, intended uses, and content experiences while retaining one jointly trained HSTU per category; lexical similarity alone cannot establish compatibility.

searches.reason: Explore an objective-only alternative after the first lexical experiment. Find approaches suitable for the fixed training budget and evaluate improvement exclusively through pinned macro validation HR@10.

searches.reason: Explore a separate temporal architecture hypothesis: jointly learned elapsed-time and relative-position conditioning inside HSTU could distinguish persistent interests from transient purchasing contexts. Existing deletion probes measure sensitivity, not intent or time effects, so seek controlled evidence and avoid assuming that stronger recency always helps.
